live_history.text: The founders have landed at Jezero. For now, air and water and warmth are all there is to think about.
Nobody is only surviving now. There are families here, and meals shared, and a place to come home to. Spring is rising over the delta.
Hard days have come back to Jezero. The colony pulls close and gets on with it. Water is on everyone's mind again. Spring is rising over the delta.
